# AgentUtils API


Every callable operation, generated from the same registry as the OpenAPI document and the MCP tool surface.

## pair_connection

Pair a runtime with an agent using a pairing code.

Exchanges a one-time pairing code for a connection credential. Codes are single-use and expire 10 minutes after issue. The HTTP route enforces per-account rate limits; exceed them and the call fails with plan_limit_reached.

- actor: public
- http: POST /v1/connections/pair
- mcp: writes, non-destructive, not idempotent
- errors: not_found, plan_limit_reached, validation_failed, temporarily_unavailable

## connection_status

Return the status of the calling connection.

Returns the connection record, the paired agent name, the account plan and the granted capabilities. Requires a valid connection credential (Bearer au_conn_…).

- actor: connection
- http: GET /v1/connections/status
- mcp: read-only, non-destructive, idempotent
- errors: authentication_required, connection_revoked, permission_denied, not_found, temporarily_unavailable

## create_agent

Create an agent owned by the account.

Creates a new agent. Names are unique per account. Owner-only: never exposed as an MCP tool.

- actor: owner
- errors: authentication_required, validation_failed, temporarily_unavailable

## rename_agent

Rename an agent owned by the account.

Renames an agent. Names are unique per account; unknown or cross-account ids are uniformly not found. Owner-only: never exposed as an MCP tool.

- actor: owner
- errors: authentication_required, not_found, validation_failed, temporarily_unavailable

## handoff_create

Create a secure credential handoff link.

Creates a handoff owned by the calling connection and returns its one-time view and submit tokens. The HTTP route applies connection rate limits.

- actor: connection
- http: POST /v1/handoffs
- mcp: writes, non-destructive, not idempotent
- errors: validation_failed, permission_denied, temporarily_unavailable

## handoff_decrypt

Decrypt values submitted to a handoff created by this connection.

Returns plaintext values only to the creating connection. Uses POST /v1/handoffs/decrypt with handoffId in the body so the shared registry has a single JSON input schema.

- actor: connection
- http: POST /v1/handoffs/decrypt
- mcp: writes, non-destructive, idempotent
- errors: not_found, resource_expired, resource_deleted, permission_denied, authentication_required, temporarily_unavailable

## handoff_close

Close a handoff created by this connection.

Crypto-erases a handoff with the done reason. Owner revocation is intentionally owner-route-only and is never an MCP operation.

- actor: connection
- http: POST /v1/handoffs/close
- mcp: writes, destructive, idempotent
- errors: not_found, resource_deleted, permission_denied, validation_failed, temporarily_unavailable

## handoff_status

Return metadata-only status for an account handoff.

Any connection in the owning account may poll non-secret metadata. Uses POST /v1/handoffs/status with handoffId in the body; it never returns field values, tokens, or ciphertext metadata.

- actor: connection
- http: POST /v1/handoffs/status
- mcp: read-only, non-destructive, idempotent
- errors: not_found, authentication_required, temporarily_unavailable
